rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for the handheld tool used to pound or drive nails.

example.english: Bring me a hammer; I need to nail this board.
example.traditional: 攞把鐵鎚過嚟，我要釘呢塊木板。
example.jyutping: lo2 baa2 tit3 ceoi4 gwo3 lei4 ngo5 jiu3 deng1 ni1 faai3 muk6 baan2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for repeatedly hammering or pounding something.

example.english: I hammer the cardboard box with my fists until it is completely smashed.
example.traditional: 我用拳頭揼個紙箱揼到爛晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 kyun4 tau4 dap6 go3 zi2 soeng1 dap6 dou3 laan6 saai3

rows.note: Use this when the main point is that someone hits something particularly hard rather than repeatedly.

example.english: I hammer the nail hard so that it goes into the wooden board.
example.traditional: 我大力打支釘，先至打得入塊木板。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 lik6 daa2 zi1 deng1 sin1 zi3 daa2 dak1 jap6 faai3 muk6 baan2

rows.note: Use this for beating a person or team by a large margin, especially in a match or competition.

example.english: Whenever we play this team, we hammer them five-nil.
example.traditional: 我哋對住呢隊波，次次都大炒佢哋五比零。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 zyu6 ni1 deoi6 bo1 ci3 ci3 dou1 daai6 caau2 keoi5 dei6 ng5 bei2 ling4
